Multiplying the matrices using the usual method, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =[\begin{aligned}-1-\text{i} & -\text{i} \\ 3 & -2+\text{i}\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}1+\text{i} & -3\text{i} \\ -4-\text{i} & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}(-1-\text{i})(1+\text{i})+(-\text{i})(-4-\text{i}) & (-1-\text{i})(-3\text{i})+(-\text{i})\cdot 6 \\ 3\cdot (1+\text{i})+(-2+\text{i})(-4-\text{i}) & 3\cdot (-3\text{i})+(-2+\text{i})\cdot 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2\text{i}+(4\text{i}-1) & (3\text{i}-3)+(-6\text{i}) \\ (3+3\text{i})+(9-2\text{i}) & (-9\text{i})+(-12+6\text{i})\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1+2\text{i} & -3-3\text{i} \\ 12+\text{i} & -12-3\text{i}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
